verdict.rationale: Steel provides browser-session infrastructure. Its CLI exposes individual step commands (start, navigate, click/fill/type, extract, stop). Orchestration is handed to external frameworks such as AgentKit, CrewAI and the agent SDKs. Nothing in the evidence documents a first-party way to compose repeatable workflows with loops, conditionals or parameters; scripting CLI commands or using third-party orchestrators is a building-block or workaround approach, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can compose repeatable multi-step workflows with loops, conditionals, and parameters instead of one-shot prompts
